attempts.intent: Investigate whether algebraic, heat-flow and geometric constructions transfer to the actual fluid equations.
attempts.outcome: This corrected reader does not certify those initial conjectural cross-problem implications. Related research is discoverable through the peer link; it is not adopted wholesale.

attempts.intent: Reconstruct the released construction with full coordinates, viscosity, pressure, forcing and correction terms.

attempts.intent: Retain the actual shear in the pulse production calculation.
attempts.outcome: The corrected edition restores the shear remainder and positive-production estimates; it also retains polynomial transport derivatives and proves the plane-coordinate inverse on its domain.
